highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 updates to Skia m153 with font-selection and GPU reliability changes.
highlights_body: Native HarfBuzz remains 14.2.1; the .300 package revision distinguishes the m153 line rather than a new shaping-engine release.

breaking.title: Pin fonts when exact Linux fallback matters
breaking.body: Linux fontconfig fallback now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort path. The selected face, glyphs, or text metrics may differ. Use an explicit family/style or a bundled typeface when deterministic selection matters.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to m153 without changing the managed API or C ABI. A servicing correction also releases the SkCachedData mutex guard before deleting the object.
Prevents partial glyph-vector updates from validating stale atlas locations and propagates native Ganesh task, flush, and submission failures. Existing C and managed flush methods remain void.

bullets.lead: Failed GPU uploads no longer feed stale draws
bullets.detail: Ganesh checks failed buffer uploads and initialization under memory pressure instead of drawing stale contents. Triangulated paths retain CPU vertex data for a later upload attempt.

Corrects the compiler-warning configuration that caused BinSkim BA2007 failures in applications consuming HarfBuzzSharp.NativeAssets.Win32. Native exports and shaping behavior are unchanged; other existing BinSkim warnings are unaffected.

preview_summaries.v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6: Preview 1 updated to Skia m153, including the Linux fontconfig fallback change and a SkCachedData lifetime correction. HarfBuzzSharp moved to the .300 package revision bucket without changing native HarfBuzz 14.2.1.
preview_summaries.v4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2: Release Candidate 1 carried release infrastructure updates; its collected PR adds no new consumer API or rendering behavior.

harfbuzz_summary: Windows native assets now pass BinSkim BA2007 after correcting how vendored-source warnings are suppressed. The native engine remains HarfBuzz 14.2.1, with unchanged exports and shaping behavior.

v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6.headline: Preview 1 introduced Skia m153, its Linux fallback-font selection change, and the cached-data mutex lifetime correction.

v4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2.headline: The release candidate prepared the m153 line for stable release without additional collected product changes.

v4.153.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 finalizes glyph-atlas and GPU-buffer failure corrections.
v4.153.0.body: It also corrects the Windows HarfBuzz BinSkim BA2007 disabled-warnings error.
